project_type: Fullstack monorepo - Next.js 15 frontend + NestJS backend + MySQL database
build_system: pnpm workspaces monorepo with turbo for task orchestration
test_framework: Jest for backend, Vitest for frontend
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install at root. 2. Run pnpm build to verify both apps compile. 3. Run pnpm test to verify tests pass. 4. Run pnpm lint to check code quality.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client generated from schema via 'pnpm --filter backend prisma generate'
setup_instructions: 1. pnpm install at root. 2. Copy .env.example files. 3. Run prisma generate.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js v22, pnpm 10.28.1 available. MySQL not running locally - schema validation only via prisma format/validate.
contribution_requirements: Monorepo structure with shared packages. TypeScript strict mode. ESLint + Prettier for formatting.
key_patterns: NestJS modular architecture with services/controllers/modules. Next.js App Router with server components. Prisma for DB access. Zod for validation. shadcn/ui components.
directory_structure: / (root) - pnpm workspace monorepo. /apps/web - Next.js 15 frontend. /apps/backend - NestJS API. /packages/database - Prisma schema and client. /packages/shared - Shared types/constants. /packages/ui - Shared UI components.
